newsitem.title: USA: Lawsuit against Astra USA CEO dismissed.
newsitem.headline: Lawsuit against Astra USA CEO dismissed.

text.p: A Norfolk County Superior Court judge has thrown out a sexual harassment lawsuit filed by three former employees of Astra USA Inc and its ousted chief executive officer.

Judge Barbara Dortch-Okara ruled this week that the three plaintiffs failed to file their complaints of sexual harassment with the Massachusetts Commission Against Discrimination within 180 days as required.
The three former employees sued Astra and former Chief Executive Lars Bildman last November alleging widespread sexual harassment at the company.
Bildman, through his attorney, has denied the accusations.
Bildman was fired as Chief Executive of the unit of the Swedish pharmaceutical company Astra AB last year.
His lawyer, Roderick MacLeish, said that Bildman is "happy that he's continuing to be successful in these sexual harassment cases."
Other employees have outstanding lawsuits filed against Bildman, who is being held without bail on criminal charges, including fraud and tax evasion.
"It is doubtful that any of these cases are going to see the light of day," MacLeish said.
A lawyer for six former Astra employees who filed a lawsuit in U.S District Court in Boston last May against Bildman and Astra was unavailable to comment on the decision.
